proposed.text: Under SPP 202, is regular construction-phase service the same as continuous eight-hour on-site supervision?

options.text: Yes; SPP 202 requires the architect to supervise continuously for eight hours each day
No; SPP 202 includes periodic site visits, and full-time eight-hour supervision is a separate service when required
Yes; continuous supervision replaces the need for certificates for payment
No; SPP 202 has no construction-phase role for the architect

proposed.rationale: SPP 202 states that the architect makes periodic site visits and is not required to make exhaustive or continuous eight-hour on-site supervision; full-time supervision is covered separately when required.
proposed.explanation: Do not treat regular construction-phase services as continuous full-time supervision unless a separate full-time supervision service is engaged.
